title: Increase Tree Spacing Visibility
description: Improve readability of the Details panel by introducing structure-driven spacing rules in shared tree primitives: minimal spacing between rows in same property group, larger gap between sibling nested groups, strongest separation plus divider between top-level property sections. Generic by hierarchy/structural role, not by section/field name.
summary: Increased all tree spacing values for more visible separation: treeBranchRowGapPx 2→4, treeSectionContentPaddingTopPx 12→20, CSS tier-3 section divider padding 10→16 and margin 6→10, CSS tier-2 group gaps 6→12, CSS tier-2 property gaps 4→8. Updated test assertion for section content padding. All 11 elements/ui tests pass.
